subject: general
question: The Jawahar Rojgar Yojana was launched in 1989 with a motive to ______ .

options.text: train the daily wage workers to look for additional income
create housing opportunities for the needy rural labours
generate foreign investment for the needy rural labours
generate wage employment for the needy rural labours

solution:
The correct answer is __**generate wage employment for the needy rural labours**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Under the Wage Employment Programmes, the National Rural Employment Programme (NREP) and Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme (RLEGP) were started in Sixth and Seventh Plans.
